items.topic: PIP dislocations: dorsal volar and volar-rotatory patterns
items.destination_intent: Hand 2026 — 3b4097df-8115-81f8-8afd-e8d1d94d7229; canonical PIP dislocation section upon explicit logging
items.teaching_point_placement: Beside comparison of dorsal volar and rotatory dislocations and tissue-specific protection
items.caption_intent: Exact supplied slide including lateral radiograph demonstrating dorsal PIP displacement and original speaker notes. Teaching clarification: dorsal dislocation implicates volar plate; volar dislocation raises concern for central slip injury requiring PIP extension protection even after a stable reduction; volar-rotatory buttonholing may occur between an intact central slip and lateral band. MCP/PIP flexion relaxes entrapped extensor structures during gentle reduction.
